entities.name: PDU session reactivation result
entities.description: Information element that indicates the result of PDU session reactivation procedures.

entities.name: Uplink data status
entities.description: Information element included in SERVICE REQUEST message indicating uplink data status.

entities.name: Allowed PDU session status
entities.description: Information element included in SERVICE REQUEST message indicating allowed PDU sessions.

entities.name: SERVICE REQUEST
entities.description: NAS message used to request service establishment.

entities.name: Uplink data status IE included
entities.description: Condition where the Uplink data status IE is present in the SERVICE REQUEST message.

entities.name: Allowed PDU session status IE included
entities.description: Condition where the Allowed PDU session status IE is present in the SERVICE REQUEST message.

entities.name: User-plane resources can be re-established
entities.description: Condition where user-plane resources can be re-established over 3GPP access for at least one PDU session.

relations.description: SERVICE REQUEST message can contain Uplink data status IE.
SERVICE REQUEST message can contain Allowed PDU session status IE.
Inclusion of PDU session reactivation result IE is guarded by presence of Uplink data status IE.
Inclusion of PDU session reactivation result IE is guarded by presence of Allowed PDU session status IE.
Inclusion of PDU session reactivation result IE is guarded by user-plane resources being re-establishable.
